title: OpenDC-LCA data-center EnergyPlus archetype extension contract

reference.source: Sun et al. (2021), Prototype energy models for data centers

purpose: Create a declared, reproducible starting point for climate-load scenario analysis. This contract does not represent AHPCC and is not an EnergyPlus result.

archetypes.cooling_system: computer room air handlers with central chiller plant

required_before_execution: pin an OpenStudio-standards or source-model revision and record its checksum
select compatible EnergyPlus and OpenStudio versions
store EPW weather file provenance and checksum
declare cooling configuration and controls for every case
review each scenario for physical validity
required_before_lca_coupling: measured or independently validated cooling performance for the technology being compared
reviewed foreground inventories and replacement rules
prohibited_interpretations: AHPCC representation without calibration and a shared-infrastructure boundary
liquid-cooling performance inferred from an air-cooled CRAC or CRAH archetype
comparative lifecycle conclusion from an unvalidated energy model
